guided_setups_completion_consistent.name: guided_setups_completion_consistent
guided_setups_completion_consistent.value: ("guided_setups"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "guided_setups"."completion_reason" IS NULL) OR ("guided_setups"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "guided_setups"."completion_reason" IS NOT NULL)

guided_setups_step_intent_consistent.name: guided_setups_step_intent_consistent
guided_setups_step_intent_consistent.value: ("guided_setups"."current_step" = 'intent' AND "guided_setups"."intent" IS NULL) OR ("guided_setups"."current_step" = 'action' AND "guided_setups"."intent" IS NOT NULL)

guided_setups_action_matches_intent.name: guided_setups_action_matches_intent
guided_setups_action_matches_intent.value: "guided_setups"."first_action_type" IS NULL OR ("guided_setups"."intent" = 'understand_behavior' AND "guided_setups"."first_action_type" = 'behavior') OR ("guided_setups"."intent" = 'train_skill' AND "guided_setups"."first_action_type" = 'training') OR ("guided_setups"."intent" = 'track_progress' AND "guided_setups"."first_action_type" = 'progress')

guided_setups_action_completion_consiste.name: guided_setups_action_completion_consistent
guided_setups_action_completion_consiste.value: ("guided_setups"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "guided_setups"."first_action_type" IS NULL AND "guided_setups"."first_action_id" IS NULL) OR ("guided_setups"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "guided_setups"."completion_reason" = 'first_action_completed' AND "guided_setups"."current_step" = 'action' AND "guided_setups"."intent" IS NOT NULL AND "guided_setups"."first_action_type" IS NOT NULL AND "guided_setups"."first_action_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("guided_setups"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "guided_setups"."completion_reason" = 'skipped' AND "guided_setups"."current_step" = 'action' AND "guided_setups"."intent" IS NOT NULL AND "guided_setups"."first_action_type" IS NULL AND "guided_setups"."first_action_id" IS NULL) OR ("guided_setups"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "guided_setups"."completion_reason" = 'abandoned' AND "guided_setups"."first_action_type" IS NULL AND "guided_setups"."first_action_id" IS NULL)

guided_setups_active_dog_required.name: guided_setups_active_dog_required
guided_setups_active_dog_required.value: "guided_setups"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL OR "guided_setups"."dog_id" IS NOT NULL
